message.content: {"note_claim": "The Andrew Garfield Amazing Spider-Man films from Sony and the Tom Holland MCU Spider-Man films are separate franchises.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "En febrero de 2015, Disney, Marvel Studios y Sony hicieron un trato para introducir una nueva versión de Spider-Man que se introdujo e integró en el Universo cinematográfico de Marvel.", "reason": "The page shows that Garfield's Amazing Spider-Man duology and Holland's MCU version are distinct series, but the visible text never mentions Woodley, Zendaya, or Mary Jane casting."}

parsed.note_claim: The Andrew Garfield Amazing Spider-Man films from Sony and the Tom Holland MCU Spider-Man films are separate franchises.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: En febrero de 2015, Disney, Marvel Studios y Sony hicieron un trato para introducir una nueva versión de Spider-Man que se introdujo e integró en el Universo cinematográfico de Marvel.
parsed.reason: The page shows that Garfield's Amazing Spider-Man duology and Holland's MCU version are distinct series, but the visible text never mentions Woodley, Zendaya, or Mary Jane casting.
